data.promptProse: Sitting comfortably at the polished cafeteria counter on a high stool, Surtr enjoys a tall sundae dish with a small silver spoon. A pendant warm lamp casts a soft spotlight over the dessert and her relaxed, content expression amidst the dim cozy surrounding lounge.
